$comment: Guardrail wiring. Claude Code only reads hook and permission config from this file — a hook script in .claude/hooks/ that is not listed here never runs. See AGENTS.md. Hooks use exec form (node + args: no shell, cwd-independent through ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}) with onFailure: block, so a hook that crashes, times out or cannot start blocks the call instead of letting it through.
$comment2: Approves the figma and linear servers from .mcp.json by name rather than using enableAllProjectMcpServers, so adding a server to .mcp.json is still a deliberate act. Headless sub-agent runs cannot answer the approval prompt and would otherwise silently run without those tools.
